capabilities: Transcribe audio embeds into Markdown transcripts via a speech-to-text service
Insert the transcript directly below the audio reference in the editor
Split transcripts into one-minute sections using returned timestamps
Auto-transcribe audio references when typed, pasted, or dropped into a note
Upload local audio files to Litterbox as temporary public download URLs
extras: Privacy warning: before transcription, local audio is uploaded to Litterbox as a public download URL that anyone with the URL can access until it expires; the author advises against uploading sensitive or confidential recordings. The plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff and is still being prepared for community publication.
problem: Obsidian lets you embed audio recordings in notes but offers no way to turn those recordings into text transcripts.

relations.evidence: The default model is qwen3-asr-flash-filetrans from Alibaba Cloud Model Studio (DashScope).
Uploads local audio to Litterbox as a temporary public download URL before submitting the asynchronous task.

summary: Speech-to-text plugin that transcribes audio embeds into timestamped Markdown sections via configurable cloud transcription services.
